description: desired.v1 §2.6 to §2.10: one target's role, its slice's key (key; null for a role left unbound, §2.12), and the steps it takes, in order -> what each step does, and the report after the last. A step is one of: {sample: {from, kind, stamp, revision?}}, a sample or a reply received from either path (§2.5), from "owner" (the author's own answer or put) or "archive" (an archive's last-known, §2.9), its kind "put" or "delete" (a delete or a reply_del), its stamp {time, id} (time an NTP64 value, id lowercase hexadecimal without leading zeros, as core's seed/merge.json writes one) or null for an unstamped sample, and revision the document type's own when it carries one (§2.4); {finish: "done" | {refused: Refusal} | {failed: Refusal}}, the running act ends, applied whole (a put converged, a delete reverted), refused whole, or failed partway (a refusal of a revert is read as a failure); {call: true}, the target's own operation changed what is in force; {restart: true}, a new instance of the target, holding nothing. The target starts holding nothing, its report {key, source: baseline} ({source: baseline} with no key). expect.steps: for a sample, unstamped (no stamp), same_version (the stamp of the version held: the running or last act's, or the one held waiting; the author's own sample of a version held from an archive is confirmed instead, and the report's last_known goes), older (the held version's id, an earlier time), held (admitted while an act runs: it replaces any version held waiting), act or revert (admitted, and the act starts: nothing held, or a later time of the held id, or another id); for finish, done, or act or revert when a held version starts; called; restarted. A version is admitted against the one held waiting if there is one, else the last acted on. expect.report is the Report after the last step, as §2.10 builds it: observed the last version acted on, its stamp written time/id (in decimal, then the id), and its revision for a put that has one; converged: source desired, in_force the version; refused: source and in_force as they were; failed: source desired for a put, baseline for a delete, no in_force; reverted: source baseline, no in_force; last_known true when the act's version came from an archive and no author's sample confirmed it; call: source call, no in_force.
